findings.text: At 1920 the "Say something" box and the open AI drawer on the right show the same global chat at once: two composers, two "Pick up where you left off?" prompts (shots/1920.png, top-left card and right drawer). It is one component, reused as the brief asked (AIDashboard.js:188, `keep: true`), but when the drawer is open the card repeats it. Consider hiding the card while the drawer is open.

"Ready to merge" still reads 0 (shots/1920.png, Needs you card and the orange pill). The minion traced this to Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs not reading module `tasks/` folders, and says worktree/merge-list-module-tasks (ac6d8605c) fixes it (session.jsonl, decision log). Merge that branch with this one, or the owner's one decision still shows a wrong 0.

The "Usage pace" card (item 6) is missing from both shots because the worktree has no gitignored usage.json, and UsageLine.js:15 then removes the card. The code path is correct; it just hasn't been seen on screen. Check it on the main site after the merge.

DashQueue.js:369-373 saves and restores `QueryClient.current` from outside the class to get a one-shot query. It works: replies come back on `socket.request`, and only pushes route through `current` (QueryClient.js:37-38). A `live: false` option in the QueryClient constructor would be simpler and safer, and it would also close the one-live-client limit filed in ext/Query/improvements.jsonl.

Nothing imports SessionStore.js, SessionTree.js, SessionRow.js, DayStrip.js or OriginChips.js in ai/AIDashboard/ any more (grep: their only callers are each other). The readme says so (readme.md:458), but under the never-destructive rule they belong in ai/archive/retired/ rather than sitting live beside the dashboard. The day strip and origin grouping the old page had are now on no page; /framework/ai/sessions/ is a different list.

The Needs-you rows show the same item twice: "Checkup on everything the voice sessions started" (shots/1920.png and shots/390.png, Needs you card, rows 1-2). That is probably duplicate data in Servex `/waiting`, not this code, but it is the first thing the owner reads. DashNeeds.js:338 could drop duplicates by title or card.

On a 1920 screen the pill row (the links one click down) sits under the content at about y=945, and the grid ends with about 330 px of empty page below it (shots/1920.png). That is fine, but the Sessions link the brief names is easy to miss at the bottom.

answer.reply: noted: the fix is worktree/merge-list-module-tasks (ac6d8605c, reviewed); asked vscode-mastermind who lands it, and will merge it after the dashboard if nobody owns it (Servex sees it after a sustain restart).
noted: the mastermind checks the usage line on the main site right after the merge (usage.json exists only in the main tree).

declined for this task: a `live:false` QueryClient option is a core change to ext/Query, already filed in ext/Query/improvements.jsonl; the save-and-restore of QueryClient.current works and is commented.
